situations.headline: FOS Capital SPP to raise up to $1.25m at $0.12 following $1.86m placement

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: FOS Capital SPP to raise up to $1.25m at $0.12 following $1.86m placement (interest 3, risk 6)

thesis.text: FOS Capital is a small-cap ASX company undergoing successive dilutive capital raises (placement + SPP) to fund working capital across its Queensland Schools Lighting and Aldridge Traffic Systems operations while simultaneously running a cost-reduction program, signalling near-term liquidity pressure rather than growth-driven equity issuance; monitor subsequent announcements for shortfall placements, further capital raises, or going-concern language that would confirm balance-sheet stress.
